# bintables/shr

> >> : `sar`, by a constant or by cl.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/shr.pkg) · translates [std/shr](../std/shr.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when right is int`

```nasm
{left}
sar rax, {right.value}
```

### `emit`

```nasm
@binop
mov rcx, rbx
sar rax, cl
```

Includes: [bintables/binop](binop.md)
